Are you an experienced security engineer who combines technical expertise with a customer-focused approach? We are looking for a Senior Security Engineer to help organisations design, implement and maintain security solutions across the Microsoft ecosystem. You will work across identity, endpoint protection, cloud security and security monitoring, combining advisory responsibilities with hands-on delivery. Apply today and turn security requirements into practical improvements!
Key responsibilities
Design, implement and maintain security solutions across Microsoft environments, covering identity, endpoints, cloud services and security monitoring.
Provide technical expertise across relevant Microsoft Security technologies, including Entra ID, Defender for Endpoint, Defender for Cloud, Sentinel and Intune.
Support incident handling, security monitoring and ongoing activities to strengthen customers’ security posture.
Assess customer needs and translate technical security requirements into actionable recommendations and business-relevant improvements.
Collaborate closely with business stakeholders, IT teams and external providers to deliver and operate security solutions.
Act as a technical specialist in customer engagements, combining security advisory with hands-on configuration, implementation and operational support.

Ideal candidate profile
Senior-level experience designing, implementing or maintaining security solutions in Microsoft environments.
Documented expertise in several of the following: Microsoft Entra ID, Defender for Endpoint, Defender for Cloud, Sentinel, Intune, Microsoft 365 Security and Azure.
Experience in incident handling, security monitoring or security improvement initiatives.
A background in working closely with business stakeholders, IT teams and external providers; consulting or other customer-facing experience would be an advantage.
Post-secondary education in IT, cybersecurity or a related field; a relevant university degree and Microsoft certifications in Security, Identity or Azure are advantageous.
An independent, accountable approach, strong communication skills and the ability to work both strategically and hands-on; experience with Zero Trust, IAM/PAM, security architecture or organisations in energy, industry or critical infrastructure would be an advantage.
Fluency in both Swedish and English.

Conditions
Location: Stockholm
Work Model: Hybrid
Employment Type: Full-time employment

Recruitment steps
Initial call with a KUBO recruiter
Interviews with the client
Decision and feedback

Company description:

Job description:   Join our Team   About this opportunity:
  
 Want to take a challenge to shape a new world of communications?
 Join Ericsson's Purpose Build RAN Layer 1 Software organization and help build the technology that powers next-generation mobile networks.
 We are looking for SW Engineers who want to work with us to increase our customers’ satisfaction with 5G Baseband SW as well as to develop a new 6G RAN technology. Here you get opportunity to work alongside experience developers to learn how Ericsson system is designed, implemented, tested and integrated.
 This is a great opportunity for those of you who are eager to learn, adaptable, like solving technical problems and really enjoy collaborating.
  
 What you will do:
  
 •    Develop and maintain Ericsson's Purpose Build RAN Layer 1 Baseband software•    Develop a new generation of RAN SW (6G)•    Use AI-assisted engineering tools to support your activities like developing code, test creation, debugging, documentation, and code review•    Learn how 5G/6G radio systems and physical layer processing work•    Participate in feature development, debugging, testing, code reviews, and continuous integration activities•    Collaborate with software developers, architects, system engineers, and testers across global teams•    Work with software quality, test coverage, maintainability, and continuous improvement•    Explore and contribute to AI/ML-enabled features that may be implemented in the product•    Grow your technical skills through mentorship, feedback, and hands-on experience

Review the existing playback architecture, including AVFoundation, buffering and error handling.

Deep knowledge of streaming protocols, particularly HLS; familiarity with DASH and CMAF is desirable.

Strong experience with AVFoundation, AVKit and audio session events.

Experience with DRM and content protection, including FairPlay Streaming and key delivery.

Expertise in offline playback, download management and license renewal strategies.

Proven ability to debug playback failures in production using analytical tools.

Understanding of QoE metrics and how to implement playback quality measurements.

Strong Swift and modern iOS development skills, with familiarity with SwiftUI and reactive programming patterns.

Ability to work independently, collaborate across teams and provide clear technical recommendations.

Interest in Chromecast integration.

⭐ Nice to Have
Experience with CarPlay or Apple Watch media features.

Background in audio-focused applications such as podcasts or audiobooks.

Knowledge of backend and CDN processes, including transcoding and access management.

Experience with large-scale consumer applications and subscription models.

Experience with Android ExoPlayer/Media3.

Familiarity with Swedish or Nordic media services.

📍 Assignment Details
Location: Stockholm, Sweden

Start: As soon as possible, with flexibility

Duration: 6–9 months; final duration to be confirmed

Work model: Hybrid in Stockholm

Language: Professional proficiency in English

Seniority: Senior

Company description:
Ericsson AB
Job description:   Join our Team   Join our Power Design Team
  
 About this opportunity
 Are you an experienced power electronics engineer who enjoys combining circuit design, analysis and hands-on laboratory work?

As part of our global design organization, you will contribute throughout the product lifecycle—from early concept studies and requirements definition to detailed design, verification and product maintenance.

 The skills you bringRequired qualifications•    Master’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Power Electronics or a related field.•    Several years of relevant experience in power electronics.•    Experience with DC/DC converters and power distribution.•    Practical experience with laboratory verification and electronic measurement equipment.•    Good understanding of hardware design and how power solutions are integrated into complex products.•    Experience using AI-assisted tools or methods in engineering, analysis, automation or technical documentation.•    Strong interest in circuit design and hands-on problem solving.•    Fluent English, both spoken and written.
  
 Additional experience that is beneficial•    Knowledge of simulation tools such as SIMPLIS, LTspice or PSpice.•    Experience with scripting or calculation tools such as Python, MATLAB or Mathcad.
  
 You are structured, analytical and able to work independently while collaborating effectively with others. You communicate clearly, adapt to changing priorities and take ownership of delivering results.

Collaborate with design, maintenance, and facility engineering teams to prepare, commission, operate, and improve test facilities and ground support equipment.
